items.body:
Prior task outcome: success.

Observed: The customer was authenticated using name and ZIP after not recalling the account email. Order #W9300146 was reported as pending, with the black/low/USB Desk Lamp (item 9190635437) priced at $153.23. Product details showed the least expensive available Desk Lamp was item 5320792178 (black/medium/AC adapter) at $135.24. Before modifying, the assistant stated the replacement, $17.99 gift-card credit, one-time modification limit, and that the order could not subsequently be modified or cancelled; it asked the customer to confirm both the change and that this was the only item. After the customer explicitly agreed, the modification tool returned the new lamp, status “pending (item modified),” and a $17.98999999999998 refund transaction to gift card gift_card_7245904. The assistant then confirmed $17.99 to the customer.

Evidence-supported lesson/caution: For this observed pending-order item change, verify the order status and available same-product variants, identify all items the customer wants changed, disclose the irreversible one-time modification constraint and price difference, and obtain explicit confirmation before acting. The tool response supports that this specific change and gift-card refund were recorded; it does not establish how other order states or payment methods behave.
